purpose: Lints a stablecoin token's declared admin-role configuration for separation of duties, key concentration and issuance-policy fit, over ROLE LABELS ONLY. Given a profile (fiattoken per the pinned Circle stablecoin-evm role contracts, usdp per the pinned Paxos contracts, or generic caller-declared), holder kinds (eoa, multisig, timelock, hsm_service), a role-to-holder map, per-minter allowances and a caller-declared issuance policy, it reports: distinctness pairs held by the same label; labels holding multiple critical roles and single-signer holders of critical roles; per-minter and total allowance breaches; and whether pause, freeze and upgrade capabilities exist and who holds them. Verdict PASS, PASS_WITH_FINDINGS or FAIL, each finding cited to the pinned source or marked caller-declared policy. Any value resembling an address, public key or private key refuses the call. No statutory claims are asserted; configuration lint only, no live-chain reads. Naming a profile describes that role model and implies no endorsement by Circle or Paxos.
control_description: Separation-of-duties, key-concentration, issuance-allowance and capability-holder lint over role labels only, with profile semantics pinned to Circle stablecoin-evm (commit fc85788b) and Paxos usdp-contracts / paxos-token-contracts (commits 1af2c7f0 / 674ac104); every rule without a pinned source is caller-declared policy and is cited as such in the finding.
